title: Send Client Updates with Clear Charts
summary: Turn the reports and statements you already have into one clear chart per point, so client and investor updates take minutes and get read.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you already send client or investor updates; the value is chart-building time saved.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Updates go out faster, so you spend more hours on paid work.
Clients see results at a glance, which helps renewals.
who_its_for: Consultants and agencies that report to clients.
Founders who update investors or a board.

steps: Collect the reports for this update.
Make one chart for each point you want to make.
Check every number and send the update yourself.
guardrails: Check every chart against its source before it leaves your hands.
Upload client files only if your agreement allows it.
